failureReason: MockTransportTests referenced MockTransport and MockTransportCompletion before the production double existed; every reference reported 'cannot find MockTransport in scope'.
targetDiscoveryNote: Before the KVMCoreTests target existed, this command resolved upward to the root package and ran only the 3 pre-existing scaffold tests, so the Exact Test File was never compiled. The Product Owner authorized adding the KVMCoreTests target to the root Package.swift for exactly this reason.
remediation: Added only the package-visible MockTransport double, its component documentation, and the KVMCoreTests target; all 15 package tests then passed.
